Perfectio X
description:
Short Description
An advanced LED light therapy device that combines red and infrared light to enhance skin rejuvenation. Perfectio X promotes collagen production, reduces fine lines, and improves skin texture for a more youthful and radiant appearance.

What It Does & Benefits
Perfectio X utilizes both red and infrared light to stimulate the skin at a deeper level, helping to firm, tighten, and smooth the complexion. It improves skin elasticity, reduces signs of aging, and promotes a glowing, youthful appearance.

Instructions
Turn on the device and gently glide it over clean, dry skin for 10-20 minutes per treatment area. Use 3-4 times a week for optimal results. Follow with your regular skincare routine.

Active Ingredients
Red LED Light
Infrared LED Light

Full List of Ingredients (INCI)
Not applicable, as the device uses light therapy without topical ingredients.

Skin Type
Suitable for all skin types, particularly those with signs of aging, fine lines, and skin laxity. Safe for sensitive skin.
